boundary: This local supplemental program, its eight implementers and nonpersonal marker resources; no all-company assertion
exception_handling: Open deficiency with owner, due date and separate effectiveness observation; latest successful run does not cure missed-period deadline
frequency_and_trigger: First day each Sep-Dec month at 09:00 UTC; due third day 17:00 UTC. Material changes and new concerns trigger an additional review.
objective: Keep named service responsibilities, active security decisions and documentation availability aligned as the restricted-hosting model changes
outputs: Independent Legal challenge where missing or overdue
steps: Resolve exact effective instruction and confirm named owners
Reconcile required recipients against actual delivery and contact address
Confirm each retained document can be retrieved unchanged
Check every applicable local risk decision and retain exceptions
Sign factual result and assign correction with due date; do not declare complete when an input is missing
